instruction: Fix `rotate` in `seqops/transforms.py` so a rotation count larger than the list length is handled correctly. It currently uses `k` directly without reducing it modulo the length, so `rotate(items, k)` with `k > len(items)` returns the unrotated list.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/transforms.py b/seqops/transforms.py
--- a/seqops/transforms.py
+++ b/seqops/transforms.py
@@ -23,6 +23,7 @@
     n = len(items)
     if n == 0:
         return []
+    k %= n
     return items[-k:] + items[:-k]
